client: Claude Code (cloud session) MCP client, connector DD, catalog full
method: Passive: the client's own loaded tool list and server instructions. No dd_owner_* tool was called; no live grant was read or changed; no credential is recorded.
initialize_said: Catalog `full`: 88 of 88 tools are callable here.
diagnosis: Count: production initialize counted MCP_TOOLS (88) only, while tools/list appended the 4 opted-in owner tools (92). Fixed in PR 1: both now count owner tools.

Schema: the client collapsed each top-level oneOf to its FIRST branch. dd_owner_pound_write was presented as op const 'task.save' with the task data shape only; dd_owner_bdb_write as type const 'hypothesis' only. message.add, context.save, evidence and discussion were therefore not expressible from this client. PR 1 replaces both with one flat object schema; the exact oneOf moves to the read result's writeSchema.

dd_owner_pound_write.description_prefix: Input constraint: Provide parameters for exactly one of: (op, expected_revision, request_id, data).

dd_owner_bdb_write.description_prefix: Input constraint: Provide parameters for exactly one of: (type, key, payload).

also_found_not_changed: Public tools dd_correct_bozo_pick (oneOf), dd_submit_bozo_leg (anyOf) and dd_verify_bozo_entry (anyOf) also carry a top-level combinator. Out of scope for this plan; listed as a known gap.
